Kill [[Quansong Spiritspeak]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Quansong Spiritspeak in [[Tahnnakai Temple (explorable area)|Tahnnakai Temple]].
* *BONUS* Kill Quansong Spiritspeak in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Head north through the Tahnnakai Temple explorable area from [[Zin Ku Corridor]]. Be prepared for [[area of effect]] [[fire damage]] from the [[Temple Guardian]]s around him. If you follow the path in the [[:File:Quansong Spiritspeak map.jpg|the map posted on the right]], you will only encounter Temple Guardians on your way to Quansong Spiritspeak. 

===Skill recommendations===
* You will not encounter any [[physical attack]]ers, so skills that [[block]], cause [[miss]]es, or inflict the [[blind]] condition are less effective here; however, Temple Guardians have [[Stun on Critical Hit]].
* Quansong Spiritspeak and Temple Guardians are not [[fleshy]] creatures, so skills that exploit [[corpse]]s and inflict [[bleeding]], [[disease]], or [[poison]] are ineffective against them.
* You will only encounter [[spellcaster]] [[mob]]s, so consider bringing [[anti-caster]] skills and/or various Ranger [[nature ritual]]s that can benefit your [[party]] but cannot benefit the Temple Guardians (such as [[Favorable Winds]], [[Infuriating Heat]], and [[Winnowing]]).
* Temple Guardians have less [[armor rating]] against [[cold damage]], so consider bringing [[Winter]] or skills that deal cold damage. Consider bringing [[Water Magic]] hex spells that [[Snare (tactic)|snare]] and deal cold damage (i.e. [[Deep Freeze]], [[Ice Spikes]], [[Mind Freeze]], and [[Shard Storm]]), which will slow their movement speed and can help in preventing them from reaching your [[Team roles|midline/backline]] and dealing [[point blank area of effect]] damage from Temple Guardians' [[Double Dragon]] and [[Quansong Spiritspeak]]'s [[Ancestors' Rage]].
* Temple Guardians have less armor rating against [[blunt damage]], so consider using a weapon that deals blunt damage.
